text:
maria: Heads-up: Cloud Onramp refkit kickoff. Need terraform modules, one-click template, AMI guidance, and a tiny inference demo w/ dashboards by EOW. Who volunteers?
aj: I'll own terraform modules + publish to registry. I'll include network/compute/observability split, CI (tflint/tfsec/validate) and a smoke terratest.
devon: I'll produce the AMI and instance guidance doc. Cloud partner asked explicitly for arm64 + ROCm notes. Will include recommended kernel params and driver versions. Link to WIP: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/ami-wip
samir: I'll do the demo app and the cost/latency runbook. Plan: small Flask app that calls /v1/generate and exports Prom metrics. I'll add a k6 smoke script.
elaine: I'll prepare the marketplace package and the partner-facing quickstart. Cloud needs a one-click CloudCo template + short demo clip. I'll also draft the announcement copy.
marketplace-bot: checklist:update required_artifacts = docs, quickstart, terraform_registry_entry, smoke_test, support_contact.
aj: sample snippet for README to include in module: ```hcl
module "refkit_compute" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/compute"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  image_id = var.image_id
  node_count = 2
}
```
maria: Keep examples minimal and copy-paste ready. Also expose a `quant_profile` var so partners can opt into int8 runtime.
devon: I'll add a compatibility table (x86_64/arm64, CUDA/ROCm) and mark images with tested kernels.
samir: For reproducible cost numbers I'll include a script: `scripts/run_cost_bench.sh` with seed, batch size, seq len flags.
elaine: I'll need the demo deploy URL + Grafana dashboard link before I finish the marketplace page.
aj: Timeline: scaffold PR by Tue, publish v0.1.0 to registry after tests.
maria: Action: i'll open a tracking issue and assign. Quick sync with CloudCo PM tomorrow 10am PT; aj & devon pls join.
devon: can do.
aj: on calendar.
samir: can join first 15 mins.
elaine: attending.
maria: Thanks — ping updates here. :rocket:
